title: A clone without Python says so at session start
goal: When _tools/kbpy finds no Python 3.11+, a synchronous SessionStart hook in the clone's settings and the plugin prints one systemMessage to the user naming what failed and how to install Python (on Windows: _tools/install-python.ps1), instead of every hook exiting 127 in silence.
notes: Today kbpy prints its message to stderr and exits 127, and each hook fails silently on every prompt and tool call. Only a synchronous SessionStart hook that prints a JSON object with systemMessage reaches the person (claude/hooks.md:65, DER S743).
